corrections.text: The summary says SiliconANGLE 'calls its 100 ms latency a claim, Blocks & Files an aim'. Neither outlet gives a flat 100 ms figure: SiliconANGLE says Edelbyte claims it can query multipetabyte datasets 'with under 100 milliseconds of latency', and Blocks & Files says the company aims to make performance 'less than 100 ms' practical at a hundreds-of-petabytes scale. Both attribute the figure to the company, and neither reports a test.
